title: Load current analytics before optional trends and recover failed requests
summary: Remove the comparison request from the critical loading path and reduce repeated navigation badge traffic.

changes.detail: Bound analytics requests; show retry after failure; cancel obsolete period requests; prevent older responses replacing the selected period.

Render current analytics before requesting compact comparison totals; omit duplicate full historical views/sessions from comparison response; delay badge reads and refresh once per minute instead of every navigation.
